earnings.title: Contact: Christopher Ford
highlights: GAAP net income of $0.70 per share and Adjusted (non-GAAP) operating earnings of $0.87 per share for the third quarter of 2026, above expectations
Exelon's GAAP net income for the third quarter of 2026 decreased to $0.70 per share from $0.86 per share in the third quarter of 2025.
ComEd's third quarter of 2026 GAAP net income increased to $406 million from $373 million in the third quarter of 2025.
PECO’s third quarter of 2026 GAAP net income decreased to $165 million from $250 million in the third quarter of 2025.
BGE’s third quarter of 2026 GAAP net income increased to $90 million from $82 million in the third quarter of 2025.

quotes.text: Exelon delivered $0.87 adjusted operating earnings per share in the third quarter.
quotes.by: Exelon Chief Financial Officer Rob Kleczynski

outlook: Narrowing full year 2026 Adjusted (non-GAAP) operating earnings guidance range to $2.85-$2.91 per share and affirming operating EPS compounded annual growth near top end of 5-7% from 2025 to 2029
